faqs.q: How long should I wait before following up on a deal?
faqs.a: Five days is a sensible start: long enough that you are not chasing, short enough that the deal is still warm. Change it in one sentence, for example 3 days for big deals and 7 for small ones.

faqs.q: Will it email my contacts without asking me?
faqs.a: No. Every follow-up waits in Needs you until you approve it, change it or decline it. AI agents ask before sending, even to you, until you allow otherwise in Settings.

faqs.q: How does it know a deal has gone quiet?
faqs.a: It starts from your Gmail threads: emails you sent that got no answer. It then finds the matching contact and deal in HubSpot and leaves out deals that are won, lost or answered.

faqs.q: Does it change anything in HubSpot?
faqs.a: It reads deals, contacts and notes. Adding a note to a contact is a change in an outside app, so that asks you first too.

faqs.q: Does it run the moment a contact goes quiet?
faqs.a: No. An AI agent runs on a schedule, here every weekday at 9:00, or when you ask it in its chat. It does not react to each email as it arrives.
